description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC filter `ValidatorActionFilter` that implements validation logic for controller actions. It intercepts the action execution, checks model state validity, and returns detailed error responses in JSON format if validation fails.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: A custom ASP.NET Core MVC action filter that validates model state before executing an action. If invalid, it responds with a JSON object containing validation errors and sets an HTTP 422 status code.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the model state is valid; if not, constructs an error response in JSON and sets the HTTP status code to 422. It then short-circuits the action execution by setting the result.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: No implementation; required by the IActionFilter interface but not used here.
